title: Provider
description: One registrar/hoster (data/providers/<id>.json). The file name must equal `id`.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the contracting entity.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in basis points applied to this provider's net prices (1900 = 19 %). null: the provider makes no VAT statement (outside the EU only, checked by validate-data); net offers of such a provider need their own `vat_rate`.

country_note.description: Short German note on the contracting party or invoicing, e.g. when another entity of the provider invoices EU customers. Shown as a footnote on the "Land" cell and next to the country in the row detail.

operator.description: true only for the portal operator's own offer (badge 'Angebot des Portalbetreibers'). Never affects sorting.

terms.description: Contract terms (AGB) as found, manual collection (stage C).

section.description: Where in the terms the cited rules are.

notes.description: Editorial notes per contract field, shown as a footnote on that table cell (e.g. conflicting clauses, a value that is only a lower bound). Keys are the contract field names above; every note must be quotable from the cited terms. A note applies only where the provider value is used, not where offer.contract overrides the field.

collection.description: How tldcost collects this provider, for the list on the Methodik page (/methodik/#erhebung-je-anbieter). The method itself (api, scrape, manual) comes from evidence.method of the offers. status: excluded = no offers because the provider does not meet the selection criteria (Methodik, Anbieterauswahl); pending = no offers yet, manual entry outstanding. Without status, reason is a note on gaps (e.g. TLDs left out). validate-data: a provider without offers needs a status, a provider with a status has no offers.

reason.description: Short German reason, shown on the Methodik page.

issue.description: GitHub issue that tracks it; linked on the page only while the repository is public.

reviewed_at.description: Last manual review of terms and features (90-day cycle).
